author: TeIq
content: Delivered: SimhashIndex trait + MemorySimhashIndex with rolling-window VecDeque-based eviction. NonZeroU8/Duration/NonZeroUsize typed config (compile-time invariants for thresholds). hamming_distance via native count_ones() popcount. ClusterObservation typed value carrying hash + members + max_pairwise_distance + confidence (f32, clamped). Per-entry cluster_emitted flag prevents re-emission as the brigade grows. Same-subject contributions ignored for distinct-member count. 5 scenario tests + 2 hamming sanity + 2 proptest properties (hamming_bounded, identical_always_cluster) all pass. polaris-backend/src/pattern/{mod,simhash}.rs + proptest workspace dep + lib.rs module wiring. Redis-backed impl deferred (parallels #56 pattern); ObservationRepo persistence is pattern-engine driver concern, not detector.
